content.text: Font requested at `/font/acme-sans.woff2` but the folder is `site/fonts`.

input.command: ls site/fonts; grep -rn "woff\|font-face\|Acme Sans" site --include=*.css --include=*.html | head
sed -i "s#url('../font/acme-sans.woff2')#url('../fonts/acme-sans.woff2')#" site/css/tokens.css && git diff && npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts 2>&1 | grep -A2 "TestivAI Visual"

summary: Fix font path and re-run visual tests

content.text:
I found the problem and fixed it. The site's custom font, Acme Sans, wasn't loading, so every page fell back to a system font. That changed the text's look, spacing and line wrapping everywhere.

**Cause:** In `site/css/tokens.css:5`, the `@font-face` rule pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is `site/fonts/`. The browser got a 404 for the font file.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. That one line is the whole change.

**Checks:**
- **Before the fix:** all 12 visual snapshots (6 pages at desktop and phone size) differed from the approved baselines. The phone layouts changed most, with up to about 15% of pixels different. The report said in every case that the font had failed to load.
- **After the fix:** all 12 snapshots match the approved baselines again, so I didn't need to approve any new ones.
- The 16 functional tests also pass.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't use git history to see which edit introduced the wrong path. I haven't committed the fix.

STATUS: DONE
